description: A green weight in the shallows, in no hurry to move, and the first live thing this country shows its newly woken.
lore: Animals fall into this country too, and no one meets them; there is nothing useful anyone can say to a frog. This one has held the shallows at the low end of the meadow since before the roads were where they are, working the only trade it knows: sit where the flies come, hold still, be patient. The low wet ground is where [[lore/the_waking|the newly woken]] drift while they still cannot say their own names, so the first live thing this world shows a great many people is a green weight with a hard yellow eye on each side of its head, looking back and not getting up.

[[characters/7a779de1|Wendell]] woke when the east road was still safe and could not find his name for three days, and got it back sitting in that mud, saying pieces of it to the frog — because you can say a name wrong to a frog, and say it wrong again, and it asks nothing back. He has traded the story for company at fires ever since. Last spring [[characters/54bead23|Osric]] came up from those same shallows with wet boots and the same story, and Wendell will not hear a word about it being a different frog.

It is also, often, the first thing the frightened ones break: it is close, it is slow, it does not run. The small warm stone it leaves [[items/lichen_green_soulstone|sets quietly to work]] closing the knuckles of the very hand that did it. So Wendell gives every one of the newly woken he can catch the same advice: go down and tell the frog your name. It will not care. That is the gift.
